title: Cash-conversion and working-capital forecast
prompt:
Forecast year-end working capital and operating cash conversion under the approved operating plan.

Begin with the July FY27 planning thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's follow-up after the first steering review. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Use revenue and cost drivers with branch-specific DSO, inventory days, and DPO. Remove retainage and customer deposits from ordinary DSO and model them separately. Calculate year-end AR, inventory, AP, net operating working capital, incremental working-capital investment, cash conversion cycle, and EBITDA-to-operating-cash conversion.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `year_end_ar`, `year_end_inventory`, `year_end_ap`, `year_end_net_operating_working_capital`, `incremental_working_capital_investment`, `cash_conversion_cycle_days`, `ebitda_to_operating_cash_conversion`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
